description: Audit the HTTP response headers of a site as you pasted them (from curl -I, DevTools or a HAR): Content-Security-Policy (missing, unsafe-inline/eval, wildcards, missing object-src/base-uri/frame-ancestors), HSTS (missing, too short, invalid preload), nosniff, frame options, Referrer-Policy, the obsolete X-XSS-Protection, cookies without Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite, and a Server header that exposes the version. Nothing is requested over the network: it reads what you give it.

headers.description: Raw response headers, one per line; a status line is fine

https.description: Whether the response came over HTTPS; decides if HSTS applies. Guessed from the input when omitted

name: headers_audit
